factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance sheet: Equity 2025: 23,859 (2024: 119,371). Management report: 'The Group's equity at the end of 2025 amounted to 23,859 thousand SEK, compared to 119,371 thousand SEK at the end of 2024... In connection with this, certain holdings have been written down, in some cases to a book value of 0 SEK, based on a conservative valuation... The Board's current focus is to gradually sell, spin off, merge or otherwise liquidate remaining portfolio holdings... rather than building a broad investment portfolio.'

factual_claims.claim: The board emphasized that these declines reflect the deliberate pruning of non-core assets to concentrate capital on the AI platform and decentralized infrastructure, rather than deterioration in the core business activities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report: 'In parallel, the Company has conducted a review of its financial holdings with the aim of focusing resources on the core business within AI and decentralized infrastructure... The Board's current focus is to gradually sell, spin off, merge or otherwise liquidate remaining portfolio holdings as appropriate strategic alternatives arise... Companies may be added to the portfolio if they are deemed to be in line with the overall strategic direction within AI.' Going concern section: 'The Board of Directors believes that these items do not reflect the development in the core operational activities, where the Company has shown strong growth during the year, positive EBITDA, significantly lower financing costs and positive cash flow from operating activities during the second half of the year.'

factual_claims.claim: The group's financial position was reinforced through capital raising and debt reduction.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Going concern section: 'The Company's financial position has been strengthened during the year through completed capital raisings and lower indebtedness... During 2025, the Company was provided with capital through issues in January, March and August, and after the end of the financial year, it was also decided to issue another cash issue of approximately SEK 10 million.' Cash flow statement: Financing activities contributed positively with 44,302 thousand SEK (2024: 68,922 thousand SEK).

factual_claims.claim: Financing activities contributed a net inflow of SEK 44,302 thousand, bolstered by cash issues completed throughout the year and a further SEK 10 million issue decided shortly after period end.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement: 'Cash flow from financing activities... 44,302 (2024: 68,922)'. Significant events after year-end: 'On March 31, 2026, the Company decided on a cash issue of approximately SEK 10 million with a maximum of 45,750 shares at a price of SEK 219 per share.'

factual_claims.claim: Interest expenses plummeted to SEK 384 thousand from SEK 17,032 thousand, indicating a streamlined capital structure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 11: 'Interest expenses and similar items... Group: 384 (2024: 17,032)'. Management report: 'The negative earnings trend is mainly attributable to impairments and results from financial items, rather than the underlying operational activities... The Company has continued to have a low cost base and, in line with previous communication, has not carried out any major recruitment during the year.' Going concern: 'The Company's financial position has been strengthened during the year through completed capital raisings and lower indebtedness.'

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow from operating activities improved to minus SEK 16,662 thousand from minus SEK 29,680 thousand, with a critical highlight being the generation of positive operating cash flow totaling SEK 5,098 thousand in the second half of the year, signaling strengthening cash dynamics.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement: 'Cash flow from operating activities... -16,662 (2024: -29,680)'. Going concern section: 'During the second half of 2025, the Group simultaneously reported a positive cash flow from operating activities of 5,098 thousand SEK, which indicates a strengthened operational development.'

factual_claims.claim: Looking forward, the company focuses on scaling its Universal AI Platform, expanding distribution channels, and launching its decentralized infrastructure commercially in early 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Statement: 'Our priorities are clear: increase platform usage, expand distribution and continue developing the underlying infrastructure... We enter 2026 with a clear focus on growth, margin expansion and establishing OODA AI as a long-term player in next-generation AI infrastructure.' Expected development: 'The Group will also continue to develop the underlying infrastructure for decentralized, verifiable and secure AI computing... The next step is to take this model towards commercial deployment.' Significant events after year-end: 'On March 16, 2026, a new website and platform were published and will be offered to the public in the second quarter of 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: The board assessed that ongoing operations are viable, supported by growing revenues, improved cash flows, a lower risk profile, and adequate liquidity, ensuring the report can be prepared on a going concern basis.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Going concern section: 'The Board of Directors assesses that the conditions for continued operation in 2026 primarily rest on continued commercialization of the platform, expanded distribution through partner channels and self-service, continued cost control and the ability to provide additional capital if necessary... In light of the operational development in 2025, the capital raisings that have been completed and decided upon, and the continued streamlining of the Group, the Board of Directors assesses that the Company has the conditions to continue operating and that the annual report can therefore be prepared on the going concern basis.'
